Technical SEO Experiments.what_happened: Does adding landmarks or attraction in titles impact local SEO?. For travel sites, many searches include a place, and…

sources.name: SearchPilot Resources
sources.excerpt: Does adding landmarks or attraction in titles impact local SEO?. For travel sites, many searches include a place, and those places are often not just cities but specific landmarks and attractions, such as a theme park or a famous museum. This raises a question for any site with many individual location detail pages.  If a location has a well-known attraction, does saying so in the title help?

sources.name: aleyda
sources.excerpt: Excellent coverage by @nozzleio sharing how Google is poisoning the SERPs that it serves to rank trackers since last month ... so if you have seen rankings "off" in the latest weeks: this is your confirmation: Google has been poisoning the SERPs it serves rank trackers: complete, normal looking pages whose results have been swapped out. Nothing on the page gives it away. Each keyword’s own history does. From 27.5M analyzed SERPs: 8.0% of SERPs came back poisoned, the page looks normal. The results don’t, No error, no captcha, the same template, but most of the keyword’s usual sites are gone, the organic results keep 20.7% of the previous SERP’s sites, against 88.5% before. * Social sites…
